obernants.approximation_semantics: Exact relation target with finite correspondence evidence; no numerical surrogate claim.
obernants.assumptions: Standard Rust semantics, available allocation, and stated bounded domain. Finite checks are not a universal proof.
obernants.domain: Five tests: every low=0..79 and high=low..99; exact width cap and prime count 78498 below one million; prime squares through 997^2; trial division on the last 101 values below 10^12; six interval concatenations; empty and nonempty output fibers.
obernants.operator: Over terminating candidate implementations and pass/fail observations, exclude pass when any assertion fails and failure when all assertions hold. Nontermination and abort are outside this binary observation domain.

obernants.operator: Pass reconstructs the set of implementations agreeing on every observed fixture; off-fixture behavior is unconstrained. Failure reconstructs implementations or incorrect oracle premises that cause a mismatch, not a unique defect.
